turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, there's a whole fish on my counter staring at me. My dad caught it this morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lucky you. Whole fish is great baked in foil with lemon, or grilled until the skin goes crisp. Do you have an outdoor grill, or just the oven?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Chloe something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we bring the patio chairs inside? It's getting really windy.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably. One of them blew into the fence last time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I forgot about that. Can you grab the cushions?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Where do you want them, the garage?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, on the shelf by the bikes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Your dad's catch is still waiting. Oven or barbecue?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why does Moshi know more about football than you, Jun?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Because I've given up on football.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My hands are really small and most controllers feel huge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's more common than you'd think. Some brands make smaller controllers, and there are compact ones designed for younger players that adults use too.
